items.text: Enkaji e Solomon e nkitoo
Ilarin tomon ookuni apa etesheta Solomon enkaji enye, neidip ninye enchetata enkaji pooki.

Etesheta ninye enkaji e ntim e Lebanon; ore enkadoro enye naa ntemat enkaina iip nabo ore endapasho naa ntemat e nkaina onom, ore enkadoro eilep naa ntemat e nkaina tomoni uni, neteshetaki apa too lkererin ooiriamari okuni too ng'apeta o ltarakuai, o rishinani oltarakuai te shumata ing'apeta.
Neimulumuli apa shumata lelo gilat te lelo tarakua ootipikaki shumata nena ng'apeta artam oimiet, etii ake iltarakua tomon o imiet olkereri obo.
Netii apa irubat oo lusien olkereri ake obo, netii apa ilusien aaipira too nkaloli pokira, katitin uni.
Ore njing'eta pooki oo nkajijik o lusien naa kerisioro too nchot pooki. Ore ake elusie neipirakinore elusie katitin uni eiriamari maare.

Neitobir ninye enkaji nalala oo ng'apeta; ore enkadoro enye naa ntemat onom e nkaina, ore endapasho enye naa ntemat tomoni uni e nkaina. Netii apa olodungoro dukuya enye oitobiruno too ng'apeta, netii enkitushuret dukuya ninye.
Neitobir ninye enkaji nalala o lorika le nkitoo teine nedung'ie ninye enkiguana, aa taa enkaji e nkiguana, neitobiri too ltarakua ebaiki oltiren o metabaiki shumata enye.
1 Int 3.1

Ore enkaji enye makewan naa ninye, etonie, tiae dung'oroto te siadi ina aji nalala, naa neijia ake eikunuaki olchetei. Enyaaka ake sii Solomon aitobiru enkaji natiu anaa ena aji nalala tenkaraki entito e Farao apa nayama.

Eitobiruaki kuna pooki too soito oogol enkinyiang'a, ootaguetaki te risioroto naba anaa enairirikino, neiriri te musumeno, oriong o atua, ebaiki olkitamanyunoto o metabaiki shumata. Ore ebaiki endung'oroto e nkaji o Laitoriani o metabaiki endung'oroto kitok.
Ore apa olkitamanyunoto naa oloo soito oogol enkinyiang'a, isoito sapuki oleng, isoito loo ntemat isiet anaa ntemat tomon enkaina.
Ore shumata naa isoito oogol enkinyiang'a, ooguetuno anaa enairirikino, tenebo iltarakua.

Ore apa ina dung'oroto kitok neeta ilkererin okuni too soito oogueta oomanita o lkereri loo loom to ltarakuai, neeta sii nena ina dung'oroto e atua e nkaji o Laitoriani, o lodung'oro ojing'ieki enkaji.
Esiaai e Huram
Neirriwaa olaiguanani Solomon meyauni Huram aaitung'uaa Turo.

Olayioni apa ninye le nkoliai o losho le Naftali, ore menye naa oltung'ani le Turo, olaitobirani lo suyai; naa ngen apa ninye oleng, neeta engeno nagut sapuk o ening'unoto o enkarriyiano te nkitobirata e pooki siaai o suyai. Nelotu ninye enetii olaiguanani Solomon, neas esiaai enye pooki.
Ing'apeta are o suyai

Etipika apa ninye ing'apeta are o suyai. Ntemat tomon oisiet enkadoro e ng'ape nabo, naa enkopito ntemat tomon oare enkaina naaman ake eng'ape nabo negum nchumat enye. Ore apa enkirrushai enye naa ilkimojik oong'uan neijia apa eikununo ing'apeta pokira are.
Neitoki sii aitobir ntokitin e shumata naaikununo anaa nkopiyiani enkitoo, to suyai otosholaki, pee epiki shumata e nena ng'apeta; ore apa enkadoro entoki nabo naa ntemat imiet e nkaina.
Neitoki aitobiru ntokitin are naashetuno anaa ilmarisiani to lpisiai, nepik shumata nena ng'apeta, netii ake ina toki nashetuno anaa olmarisian shumata nabo ng'ape netii enkae shumata enkae ng'ape.
Neitoki ake sii aitobiru ilgululu oopurupurana oonyaanyukie kukumanka ilkererin oare pee eitoip nena lukuny oo ng'apeta.
Ore apa nena kikompeni naatii ilukuny e nena ng'apeta neitobiruaki anaa ntapuka, naa ntemat ong'uan e nkaina.

Netii apa nena kikompeni ilukuny e nena ng'apeta are, o shumata ina natii embata ena ripata olmarisian, netii apa ilgululu iip are, emanaa too lkererin oare, naa neija eikununo enkae toki te nchumata enkae ng'ape.

Neitasheyie ninye nena ng'apeta ntaloishin pokira are e wueji nejing'ieki enkaji e Nkai; nepik ninye eng'ape enkalo e kopikop nejo enkarna eine Yakini; neitoki, apik eng'ape enkalo e moikuape nejo enkarna enye Boas.
Ore too nchumat oo ng'apeta netii ntokitin naaitobiruaki anaa ntapuka sidain. Neaku eidipe apa esiaai oo ng'apeta.
Olmoti kitok le nkare lo suyai

Neitoki aitobir olmoti sapuk lo suyai otosholaki; naa kepurupurana ilo moti, naa ntemat tomon e nkaina ebaiki enchoto nabo e nkererema ometabaiki enkae shoto. Naa ntemat imiet e nkaina enkadoro ebaiki kop o metabaiki shumata. Naa ntemat tomoni uni emanaroto enye.
Ore abori enkererema enye netii iltuleta oomanita, ore lelo tuleta naa ilkererin oare, neenikini ilo moti metaa entoki nabo.

Neitakedi ilo moti shumata iloing'ok tomon oare lo suyai, neing'orita okuni lenye enkalo e moikuape, neing'orita okuni endoyioroto e nkolong, neing'orita okuni kopikop, neing'orita okuni enkalo o loo ntoluo; ore apa ilo moti naa shumata ninche eiteleikino. Ore enkalo enye pooki e siadi naa atua etii.
Ore endapasho enye neba anaa endap e nkaina, ore enkererema enye neikununo anaa enkererema e nkikompe, eikunuaki anaa entapukai sidai. Naa iltooi ooitukuoreki nkalifuni are enkare natii ilo moti.
Ngarrin o suyai
Enyaaka sii aitobir nkejek tomon naatonie ilo moti. Ore ake enkitotonet nabo naa ntemat ong'uan e nkaina enkadoro, naa ntemat ong'uan e nkaina endapasho, naa ntemat uni e nkaina enkadoro nailep.
Ele apa olchetunei loo nkitotoneta. Etipikaki nkeek meibung'a enkamanaa e oriong,

ore nena keek naatipikaki enkamanaa e oriong naguetakino ilng'atunyo, o loing'ok, o lkerubi. Ore enchumata nena rubat te shumata o tiabori lelo ng'atunyo, o loing'ok, netii ilmarisiani le siaai naikoduno.

Ore ake sii eeta ake enkitotonet nabo nkejek e ngarri o ng'uan o suyai o ltidii lo suyai, ore ilpijat pokira oong'uan naa ineeirisharieki ilo moti. Ore nena rishinani neikodoki too lmarisiani te pooki shoto.

Ore enjing'et enye naa enchumata enye etii neilep enkadoro e ntemata nabo e nkaina, ore ina jing'et enye naa kepurupurana naa entemata nabo olpisiai enguton. Ore ina jing'et enye neeta imolinkaishi ore irubat enyena naa kerisioro nchot pooki, mepurupurana.
Netii apa nena kejek pokira ong'uan nkeek e abori. Ore apa nkeek naaibung nkejek naa entoki nabo o nkitotoneta. Ore enkadoro enkeju naa entemet nabo e nkaina olpisiai.
Neitobiraki apa nena kejek anaa nkejek oo ngarrin oo mbartan; ore nkeek enye o enkamanaa o ltidii o eneibungare, naa ino suyai.
Neeta ake te pooki garri nkeek onguan naairishaa tiabori, naa nabo ninche o engarri.
Ore te nchumata e nkitotonet netii entoki napurupurana aa olpisiai le ntemata e nkaina enkadoro nailep; ore enchumata eina kitotonet, irishinani enyena o nkeek enyena naa entoki nabo o ninye.
Ore tioriong nena rishinani o tioriong nkeek neguetaki ilkerubi, o lng'atunyo, o iltuka, te risioroto e rishata e nabo ake enye, neitaman olmarisian.
Ore tele rrekie neitobiru nkitotoneta tomon; neitobiruni pooki aaitanyaanyuk te risioroto o te mpukunoto.
Neitobiru ninye ilmotioo tomon lo suyai; ore ake olmoti obo neeta mboreitin oo ltooi artam ooitukuoreki, ore ake olmoti obo naa ntemat ong'uan e nkaina, etii ake olmoti nkitotoneta tomon.
Nepik ninye nena kitasheta imiet enkalo e kopikop eina aji, nepik imiet enkalo e moikuape enkaji, nepik ilo moti olpijata aaitorit kopikop o loo saen leina aji.
Eumata oo ntokitin apa naaikodieki enkaji e Nkai
Eitobira apa sii Hiram imotioo, o nchempei naata ilala, o ngirran. Neaku eidipa apa Hiram esiaai pooki nataasaka Solomon tialo ina aji Olaitoriani:
nena ng'apeta pokira are, o lelo bakulini pokira oare apa otii nchumat e nena ng'apeta, o nena sosin pokira are naaimulumul ilbakulini ootii nchumat oo ng'apeta.
O lelo gululu iip ong'uan le nena sosin pokira are, ilkererin oare loo lgululu ake te sos nabo, pee eimulumul lelo bakulini oare loo nchumat oo ng'apeta;
o nena kitasheta tomon o lelo motioo tomon ootii shumata nkitasheta tomon,
oilo moti obo, o lelo oing'ok tomon oare ootii abori ilo moti.
Ore nena motioo, o nena kurteta, o ngirran, ore kuna masaa pooki naatii atua enkaji o Laitoriani, apa naaitobiraka Hiram olaiguanani Solomon, naa ino suyai otisikaki.
Ore teina kisiajata e Yordan neiturraa olaiguanani ninche teina kop e nterit natii erishata e Sukot o Seretan.
Neing'ua Solomon nena masaa pooki eitu etemi aaineneng enkaraki naa eikumok apa oleng. Ore enkiroishi o suyai neitu apa eyiolouni.
Neaku eitobira apa Solomon ntokitin pooki naatii atua enkaji o Laitoriani: ilo perere lo lasar le sahabu, ina misa e sahabu tenkaraki emukate naitisinyaki
o nkitasheta oo ltaai e sahabu nasila, imiet te nkalo e kopikop o imiet te nkalo e moikuape, eitu ebaiki ilo gilata liatua; o ntapuka, o ltaai, o ntokitin naarieki iltaai e sahabu:

o nkikompeni o nkalema o ngirran, o ntokitin e nkorropil, o ngirran e nkima, e sahabu, tenkaraki nena kikeneta e kutukaji e atua ilo gilata liatua, ine wueji nesinya aisul, o nena kikeneta olgos le nkaji e Nkai.
1 Ilai 18.11

Neaku ina siaai pooki apa etaasa olaiguanani Solomon neidipayu ina aji o Laitoriani. Neitoki Solomon ayau nena tokitin apa naaitisinya Daudi papaai lenye, ina osholai, oina sahabu o nena masaa, neshum ninche te wueji neshumishoreki tiatua enkaji Olaitoriani.
